bibl.title: Orfeo apollineo (tra lirica arcaica e critica letteraria d'età classica).
bibl.seg: Marco Ercoles, Orfeo apollineo (tra lirica arcaica e critica letteraria d'età classica).
Annali online UniFE [Università degli studi di Ferrara]. Sezione di Lettere 4 (2009) 2, pp. 47-67.
bibl.note: Bacchyl. 29 M. is considered in the light of the myth of Orpheus as represented in archaic Lyric tradition (from Eumelus to Pindar) and a general proposal of reconstruction and interpretation is put forward.
